cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I watered the fern you pointed at. Your holiday watering is done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant every plant, every day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Certainly. One teaspoon per plant each day through Sunday. That covers them all.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use a full can on each. And empty the saucers afterwards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll empty the saucers on Sunday. You specified daily watering, not daily emptying.

mechanism: A uses expert specification language to comply with plant care at the smallest stated quantity and timing, insisting each narrow completion honours the agreement.
confusable: An unskilled helper makes accidental errors; A deliberately relies on exact scope and separates daily watering from an unspecified emptying schedule.
comparison: Box alternative exploits physical location and access; plant alternative exploits quantity and recurrence.
seedUse: Single fern, daily plants, teaspoon and saucer timing derive from D47-b; S03 adds measured-dose and separate-operation corrections.
